reader_summary.overview: Classics are my favorite episodes from the past 10 years, published once a month. These are N of 1 conversations with N of 1 people. In the midst of her transition to OpenAI, we are spotlighting the force that is Fidji Simo.

key_points.text: She is the former CEO of Instacart and grew up in a small town in the South of France and was the first person in her family to graduate from high school..
Since then, she has had a dazzling career with stops at France’s leading university, eBay, and Facebook.
Fidji spent the better part of a decade at Facebook where she led the Facebook App before joining the online grocery platform, Instacart.
